test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - Reasoning Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) Some snacks are meals.

2) All juices are snacks.

**Conclusions:**

I. All juices can never be meals.

II. All meals are snacks.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5487128bd8da6cda5c23398fee0ba6e58bc2d90a673c65c338210993ebe27e0f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All juices can never be meals - FALSE (all juice are snack and some snack is meal, so some part of juice is meal so the conclusion is wrong)

II. All meals are snacks - FALSE (some meal is snack is known but there is no information about all so the conclusion dose not follows)

So, **neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
